features.scope: Castle Game Engine WebGL matrix and numeric-list bulk conversion, including contiguous-layout checks, signed-byte bounds, owned copies, reproducible baseline/candidate tests, and Phanes adoption of the exact reviewed commit through its fetchable owned-fork submodule with integrated rendering, editing, style and recovery verification. Existing buffer-upload helpers, complete application acceptance and physical-phone performance remain outside this dependency-change scope.

Stable legible lighting as the camera moves, clear high-density phone rendering with usable quality choices, recovery after mobile backgrounding or graphics loss that preserves the world and authoring session, and intuitive house interior entry and exterior return with playable desktop/phone controls.

At least 20 distinct CGE shader styles plus a default None that preserves normal rendering, real-time switching with accurate rendered feedback, custom accessible desktop/phone controls, useful adjustments and original-view comparison, preserved world state/picking/selection, and bounded rendering performance and resource lifetime.

User-accepted roughly ninefold expansion from the 905-model, six-kit baseline across all asset categories, with distinct source-model accounting, licensed provenance, Castle decode and geometry validation, coherent scale/materials, context-aware playable WFC placement, searchable desktop/phone selection, and bounded optional loading that preserves startup and ongoing world performance.
Original Phanes buttons and glyphs aligned with emergence, light and world creation, with coherent world/music styling, legible action/state feedback and usable desktop/phone controls.
Independent Phanes identity, Pascal conventions, pinned Castle/WFC web project and CI/CD starter.

Complete layered WFC world creation, kit compatibility, granular replacement, explicit selections across every camera, brush/lasso/gesture authoring, category-to-subcategory-to-item choice, playable desktop/phone controls and measured rendering scale.

Pascal generative dreamy/synth/techno soundtrack with 100 or more references, 10 or more styles, unique five-minute-plus WFC tracks with musical development, bar-aligned tempo changes preserving continuity and duration, usable sound studio and interaction effects.

Named, independently editable bays and rooms with bathroom and laboratory programs, measured furniture and usable circulation, preserved neighboring rooms and nested contents, safe save/undo transactions and intuitive rendered desktop/phone creation journeys.

Cabin interior creation using local WFC furniture and contents graphs, measured four-tier shelves, individually editable books and ornaments, tabletop props with nested plate/food assemblies, lock-aware parent and content edits, safe snapshot import/undo and usable desktop/phone inspection.
Independent critic review, four separate F-to-A grades, B+ minimum in every category, actionable builder feedback and an enforced release gate.

Independently selectable foundations and launch pads with granular persistent deck/support/panel parts, full terrain/contact/access admission, WFC material regeneration, supported buildings and retained descendants, atomic regional/document edits, rendered navigation and usable desktop/phone creation controls.

Physical scale and collision admission for current regional models, centered normalized instances, an authored cabin with a measured doorway and studio clearance, dry building datums, and usable desktop/phone exterior inspection.

WFC-generated, saved and locally editable terrain landforms, with land-cover and foliage support, exact preservation of neighboring surfaces and occupied or protected structures, shared contact and slope admission, compatible rendered chunk geometry, and intuitive desktop/phone creation journeys.

Complete touch flight and first-person movement, simultaneous axes and interruption recovery, independently collapsible and reopenable creation tools, clear Create/Explore boundaries, usable keyboard focus and phone portrait/landscape controls with consistent custom styling.

Dynamic modular homes in the surrounding world: paint connected floor regions across camera views; WFC generates compatible floors and shared walls, windows and operable doors; edit individual edges and extend a home while preserving other parts, locks and nested contents; place floor furnishings with position/facing and edit their supported contents including zero counts; walk inside and see outside with shared physical geometry, usable routes, responsive desktop/phone controls, Undo/Redo, persistence and recovery.

Bounded regional optional catalog milestone covering 18 measured models across five kits and five ecological roles, palette/category/group/item controls, exact foliage edits with surrounding-world preservation, physical scale and collision proxies, staged publication, history/session restoration, distant-chunk ownership and retirement, plus the existing book/vase publication regression. Correct directional shadow volumes for overhead, Orbit, fly and first-person cameras using conservative near-plane admission, finite closed geometry and world-derived projection bounds; ordinary and bounded cached paths must agree and preserve transformed/mutable geometry, positional-light fallback, visibility, editing and picking, styles, context recovery and desktop/mobile rendering quality and performance. Includes reviewed engine adoption; fixture success alone does not establish acceptance.
